name: Perimeter walls
summary: A Python script and its tool in My tools: four walls round a rectangle of the size you give, on the storey you choose, as one undo step.
description: An example script made by Ciuntuc BIM Studio on lapinbim, Lapin's Python package (docs/python.md in lapin-pro). Installed from Lapin Extensions, its tool Perimeter walls appears in My tools; the first click asks you to trust the script, then a dialog of Lapin's own asks for the sizes and the storey (lapin.ui.ask). From a terminal, with Lapin open: python perimeter_walls.py 8 6 2.8.

items: Tool: Perimeter walls (asks width, depth, height and storey)
